page.overview:
Who is Ellipides Tallbarrel?

is a halfling wizard and the fourth dean of the Penteveral of Dol-Makjar. As an NPC, he is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

In middle-age, Ellipides was quite handsome, with a round belly. During his deanship at the Penteveral, his slightly pointed ears appeared through white curly hair and sideburns. When Murray Mag'Nesson met with him the day he was dismissed, he had bare feet and was wearing a vest and britches.

His office at the university was beautifully appointed with a massive red wood desk carved with wooden gargoyles and panther heads with grapes hanging from their mouths. To one side of it was a small staircase leading from the floor to its top, where a smaller working desk was placed for the Dean.

He had (and possibly still has) a moth familiar named Eustace who spent time hiding in his pocket.
